prompts.title: Root cause first
Reproduce before fixing
prompts.text: Before fixing, write a minimal reproduction or failing test for this bug: {bug}

prompts.title: Diff review, bugs only
prompts.text:
Review this diff for correctness bugs only — no style or naming comments:

{clipboard}

prompts.title: Security pass
prompts.text:
Review this code for security issues (injection, authz, leaked secrets, unsafe deserialization):

{clipboard}

prompts.title: Plan before code
prompts.text:
Don't write code yet. Propose a short implementation plan for: {goal}

List the files you'd touch and the main risks, then wait for my approval.

prompts.title: Options with tradeoffs
prompts.text: Give me 2-3 approaches for {goal}, with tradeoffs, and recommend one.

prompts.title: Minimal refactor
prompts.text:
Refactor this for clarity without changing behavior. Keep the diff small:

{clipboard}

prompts.title: Scope guard
prompts.text: Constraints: don't refactor unrelated code, don't add new dependencies without asking, keep changes minimal, and ask before anything destructive.

prompts.title: Ask, don't assume
prompts.text: If anything is ambiguous, ask me instead of assuming.

prompts.title: Context handoff
prompts.text: Summarize where we are: what's done, what's in progress, what's left, and any decisions made so far. I'll use this to continue in a fresh session.

prompts.title: Explain before edit
prompts.text: Before editing, explain what the current code does and why your change is correct.

prompts.title: TLDR first
prompts.text: Give me the TLDR first, then the details.

prompts.title: Test first
prompts.text: Write failing tests for {feature} first and show them to me. Only implement after I confirm.

prompts.title: Add tests for change
prompts.text: Add tests covering the change you just made, including edge cases.

prompts.title: Commit message
prompts.text:
Write a conventional commit message for these changes:

{clipboard}

prompts.title: Explain this code
prompts.text:
Explain what this code does, at a level for someone new to the codebase:

{clipboard}
